title: Deep Koopman Iterative Learning and Stability-Guaranteed Control for Unknown Nonlinear Time-Varying Systems
summary: This paper proposes a Koopman-based framework for modeling, prediction, and control of unknown nonlinear time-varying systems. We present a novel Koopman-based learning method for predicting the state of unknown nonlinear time-varying systems, upon which a robust controller is designed to ensure that the resulting closed-loop system is input-to-state stable with respect to the Koopman approximation error.
